name: office-viewer
description: View Excel, Word and PowerPoint files in Obsidian with their real styling: xlsx, xlsm, xltx, xltm, csv, tsv, ods, docx, docm, dotx, dotm, odt, rtf, doc, pptx, pptm, ppsx, ppsm, potx, potm and odp. Read only.
